headline: Professor Murder Rides the Subway is a forgotten slice of dance punk perfection
summary: A forgotten dance-punk EP by Professor Murder Rides the Subway is rediscovered. The mid-aughts NYC band's music is praised for its concise perfection. The reviewer found the gem while re-ripping old CDs.

headline: Enormous 12TB Steam leak includes abandoned Half-Life 2: Episode 3 assets
summary: Over 12 terabytes of Steam data from 2003-2013 has been leaked online. The massive leak includes assets for the canceled Half-Life 2: Episode 3. Content cut from Portal 2 and other builds were also discovered.

headline: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter and dark energy
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has successfully launched after prior funding issues. It will travel one million miles to its orbit at the L2 point. The telescope will conduct an unprecedented survey of the universe, focusing on dark matter and energy.

headline: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state funding for Flock AI surveillance cameras. The move follows growing backlash and a report on the state's $30 million spending. Funds for the cameras were largely raised through a $1 fee on insurance policies.

headline: GTA 5's Michael Actor Defends GTA 6 After Doubters Say Rockstar's Games Look Too Similar
summary: Ned Luke, voice actor for GTA 5's Michael, defended GTA 6. He called critics who say GTA 6 looks too similar to GTA 5 "out of their minds." His comments address fan doubts about the upcoming game's distinctiveness.

headline: The Best Deals Today: LEGO Star Wars, Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake, Jurassic Park 4K Collection, and More
summary: The article highlights top deals available today. Featured items include LEGO Star Wars and Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake. A Jurassic Park 4K Collection is also among the discounted offerings.

headline: Ridley Scott's The Dog Stars Bombs in Theaters With $19 Million Global Opening
summary: Ridley Scott's film, "The Dog Stars," performed poorly at the box office. It garnered an estimated $19.3 million globally on its opening weekend. The movie is considered a box office bomb.

headline: Star Wars and Jurassic Park VFX Legend Phil Tippett Closes Studio and Auctions Memorabilia
summary: Oscar-winning animator Phil Tippett is closing his Berkeley studio. He is auctioning iconic props and memorabilia from his career. Items include props from Star Wars, Jurassic Park, and RoboCop.

headline: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC
summary: A new report reveals a high rate of early-release prisoners returning to jail. PM Andy Burnham announced changes to the next early release scheme. PC Harper's killers will remain in jail under the new scheme starting in October.

headline: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
summary: A ferry carrying nearly 270 people capsized off northern Cyprus. Eight people have been confirmed dead in the incident. A search and rescue operation is underway for missing individuals.

headline: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
summary: The US launched an attack on Iranian launchers located on Larak Island. Iran claims the strike killed several civilians. This marks the first known US strike on Iran since late July.

headline: Sons of officer who died in A66 crash lead out Man Utd as mascots
summary: The sons of fallen PC Matthew Blades served as mascots for Manchester United. They led the team out at Old Trafford for a Premier League game. The tribute was made during the match against Ipswich.
